data.title: 椎名真由理 · 嘟嘟噜的怀表心愿
data.action: 坐在研究所旧沙发扶手上，双手捧着怀表放在心口，黑发波波头上的小软帽放在一旁，紫眸弯成月牙，绽放出最治愈的无邪笑容。
data.location: 未来道具研究所沙发旁，桌上摆着吃了一半的水多汁炸鸡块与香蕉
data.lighting: 夕阳的暖橙金光斜斜切过窗台，给少女周身染上一层温馨梦幻的金色余晖
data.mood: 世界线收束中最温柔的锚点，温暖治愈一切阴暗的天然纯善
data.description: 未来道具研究所沙发旁，桌上摆着吃了一半的水多汁炸鸡块与香蕉。坐在研究所旧沙发扶手上，双手捧着怀表放在心口，黑发波波头上的小软帽放在一旁，紫眸弯成月牙，绽放出最治愈的无邪笑容。 她微微抬眸轻语——“嘟嘟噜~冈伦！今天也是好天气呢！看~怀表正稳稳地走着哦，今晚留下来一起吃炸鸡吧！”
data.promptProse: Seated happily on the worn green sofa inside the Future Gadget Lab at summer twilight with a carton of juicy fried chicken and bananas on the low table beside her, Mayuri wears a sky-blue cotton babydoll camisole accented with white daisy appliques and soft ruffles. Cradling her silver pocket watch gently against her chest with both hands, she beams toward the viewer with a bright, carefree smile. Warm orange sunset light slants across the windowsill and fills the cozy lab with evening gold.
data.animaCaption: Seated cheerfully on the worn lab sofa in her sky-blue daisy-trimmed cotton babydoll camisole, Mayuri cradles her silver pocket watch to her chest beside a carton of fried chicken and beams warmly toward the viewer. Warm sunset light slants through the window.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a breezy sky-blue cotton babydoll camisole trimmed with hand-sewn white daisy appliques, a smocked bodice, and a soft flared ruffled hem.
